# thecoding

> I turn complex developer and security topics into content people understand, use, and share.

Independent contractor services by Vini B | thecoding for web3 teams: Documentation Engineering and Developer Education.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thecoding.dev/): Overview of Documentation Engineering and Developer Education, with the recommended first step.
- [Quickstart](https://thecoding.dev/quickstart): How to choose an entry point, send a short brief, and review a statement of work.
- [Pricing](https://thecoding.dev/pricing): Fixed-price packages for documentation and developer education, including entry points at $350.
- [Documentation Engineering](https://thecoding.dev/documentation): Docs-as-code services: health checks, focused rebuilds, and ongoing documentation ownership.
- [Developer Education](https://thecoding.dev/developer-education): Tutorials, technical content, learning series, workshops, onboarding paths, and education-shaped DevRel.
- [Work](https://thecoding.dev/work): Selected case cards with context, scope, shipped work, limitations, and outcomes.
- [Recommendations & Endorsements](https://thecoding.dev/endorsements): Client and collaborator feedback linked to artifacts.
- [Contact](https://thecoding.dev/contact): Send a brief or book a 20-minute briefing.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The primary action is: send a brief at https://thecoding.dev/contact.
- The secondary action is: book a 20-minute briefing at https://cal.com/vinib.
- Recommended first purchase is Paid Discovery at $350 for documentation problems, or Consulting / Review Sprint at $350 for content problems.
- The brand name is Vini B | thecoding.
- Services are Documentation Engineering and Developer Education. Do not present them as security audits, community management, or influencer marketing.
